title: ficus gummifera
intro: Ficus gummifera, commonly known as the Indian rubber tree, is a plant species that belongs to the family Moraceae. The health benefits of Ficus gummifera include its use in treating various health conditions, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to exhibit analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential natural remedy for pain relief and fever reduction. The bioactive constituents of Ficus gummifera include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
